analysis.title: Cryptocurrency Markets: Oct 21 Spot ETP Flows: U.S. BTC ETPs' Inflows Drive Group's Net Sales of $543mn Yesterday; Weekly Flows Jump to $954mn WTD
key_insights: JPMe estimates U.S. spot Bitcoin ETP preliminary net inflows of $529mn on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, a reacceleration from the prior session's net inflows. The report's title and headline label the group's combined flows as $543mn, with BTC $529mn and ETH $14mn.
BlackRock's IBIT (+$235mn) and Fidelity's FBTC (+$213mn) led BTC flows. Grayscale's legacy GBTC added $33mn and Bitwise's BITB added $19mn.
BTC ETP aggregate notional trading volume rose sequentially to $3,153mn, in line with the running daily average of about $3,196mn/day since the January 2024 launch.

U.S. spot ether ETPs had preliminary net redemptions of $14mn on October 21, the first net sales day in six trading sessions. Grayscale's mini ETH saw $28mn of net inflows and BlackRock's ETHA saw $29mn of net redemptions. Fidelity's FETH had $13mn of net inflows.

Ether gained 1.8% on October 21, a second consecutive strong day of price appreciation per Bloomberg pricing. ETH ETP notional volume rose to $687mn, still below the running daily average of about $948mn/day since the July 2024 launch.

U.S. spot Solana ETPs reported no net new flows on October 21 after 12 consecutive sessions of daily net redemptions. Group AUM was $1,613mn at close and notional volume was $54mn, near the $53mn/day average since the October 2025 launch.
Week-to-date flows for the week ending October 23 stand at $954mn of net inflows after the strong BTC inflows on October 21, per the report's weekly flows figure title.
crypto_views: Spot BTC ETP preliminary net flows were +$529mn on Oct 21, 2026 (JPMe), led by IBIT +$235mn and FBTC +$213mn. Cumulative net flows since the January 11, 2024 launch are $60,587mn, and total AUM is $109,308mn.
Spot ETH ETP preliminary flows were $14mn on Oct 21, the first such day in six sessions, with cumulative net flows of $3,049mn since the July 23, 2024 launch and AUM of $14,206mn.
Spot SOL ETPs had flat flows on Oct 21 after 12 straight sessions of net redemptions. Cumulative net flows are $1,597mn since the October 28, 2025 launch and AUM is $1,613mn.
Average fee rates are 0.34% for BTC ETPs, 0.47% for ETH ETPs and 0.26% for SOL ETPs. GBTC charges 1.50% and ETHE charges 2.50%, against 0.15% for Grayscale's mini BTC and ETH products.
Grayscale's legacy GBTC has cumulative net flows of -$27,903mn since January 2024. Legacy ETHE has cumulative net flows of -$5,742mn since July 2024.
